name: oudeluck-breeding-planner
description: Local tool: upload two parent pedigrees, extract with a vision model, verify by hand, render a branded OudeLuck pedigree for the child bird.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute oudeluck-breeding-planner --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && npm run db:migrate:0003:local && npm run db:migrate:0004:local && npm run db:migrate:0005:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute oudeluck-breeding-planner --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && npm run db:migrate:0003:remote && npm run db:migrate:0004:remote && npm run db:migrate:0005:remote
scripts.db:seed:local:d1: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute oudeluck-breeding-planner --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed_fixtures.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute oudeluck-breeding-planner --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_fixtures.sql
